items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: That's the lady that took Mary Lou Williams' place, in Andy Kirk's band... Everybody said she was better than Mary Lou.

ctx.x: Well, he was always nice and considerate. In fact, he was like my big brother. In fact That tenor saxophone he had when he was in New York, I gave it to him. That's the one they gave me at the University, that Conn Silver Kahn (phonetic)?

The one that he liked the best of all? I gave that to him. He was very kind, but he was also going with the Countess Johnson, who I worked with later, see? When I started working down there opposite them, on 12th Street, then he started going with the Countess. And so then--
